_about: The Ashlands (levels 20-55), the burnt road to the Clockwork Foundry and the Apocalypse: the volcanic drake and the magma crawler are elites, and the Cinder Tyrant, a fire giant, holds the Magma Flows, pooling magma at your feet and calling fire elementals out of the flows.

6950.name: cinder tyrant fire giant
6950.long_desc: The Cinder Tyrant stands astride the magma, a fire giant wreathed in smoke.
6950.description: Twenty feet of black iron armour over skin like cooling lava, a beard of living flame and a greatsword glowing from the forge. He rules the Ashlands, and the fire answers him.

phases.message: The Cinder Tyrant roars, and the magma rises with him!

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.telegraph: The Cinder Tyrant drives his sword into the ground, and the earth erupts!

abilities.name: Molten Blade
abilities.telegraph: The Cinder Tyrant swings his glowing greatsword!

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.telegraph: The Cinder Tyrant raises his arms, calling down fire!

bosses.why: the Cinder Tyrant at the Magma Flows

mechanics.label: Magma
mechanics.why: magma at your feet: step out

mechanics.shout: The Cinder Tyrant bellows, and a fire elemental climbs out of the magma!
